description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractMigration for database schema migrations in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to obtain database connection, schema helper, data group helper, language helper, and config helper, along with abstract methods for defining migration steps and versioning.

classes.name: AbstractMigration
classes.description: An abstract class providing a template for database migration classes in the OrangeHRM system, with helper methods and abstract methods for migration logic.

methods.name: getSchemaManager
methods.description: Returns the schema manager for the current database connection.

methods.name: createQueryBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new query builder instance for constructing database queries.

methods.name: getSchemaHelper
methods.description: Provides an instance of SchemaHelper, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: getDataGroupHelper
methods.description: Provides an instance of DataGroupHelper, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: getLangHelper
methods.description: Provides an instance of LanguageHelper, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: getConfigHelper
methods.description: Provides an instance of ConfigHelper, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Abstract method to define schema or data modifications for the migration.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Abstract method to specify the version identifier of the migration.
